name: chest stretch with exercise ball
description: A kneeling chest stretch with one hand supported on a stability ball, letting the chest sink gently as the ball rolls away.
instructions: Kneel beside a stability ball and place one hand on it while the other hand supports you on the floor.
Slowly roll the ball away to the side and let your chest lower between your arms until you feel a gentle stretch across the chest and front shoulder.
Keep your neck relaxed and your hips steady; do not force the shoulder.
Roll the ball back, then repeat on the other side.
